dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the lateral margins starting from the mid-body and progressing toward the posterior peduncle region at the bottom of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical protrusion visible on the left lateral margin relative to the right; the right margin exhibits a more linear profile with a slight concave indentation mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity grayscale values across the entire dorsal surface with minimal pixel variance except for shadowing.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark circular aperture at the blowhole site; small dark point (potential water droplet or epidermal mark) on the anterior right portion of the head.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Longitudinal shadow-casting ridge extending along the central dorsal axis from the mid-back toward the posterior.
